mapper.insert: insert ignore into inv_quality_command ( request_id, command_type, request_fingerprint, actor_user_id, actor_username, selected_dept_id, resource_key, status, create_time ) values ( #{requestId}, #{commandType}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUsername}, #{selectedDeptId}, #{resourceKey}, 'PENDING', sysdate() )
mapper.select: select command_id, request_id, command_type, request_fingerprint, actor_user_id, actor_username, selected_dept_id, resource_key, status, result_type, result_payload, completed_time, create_time from inv_quality_command where request_id = #{requestId} for update
